name: Essex County, MA
findings: Essex County has 2,862 nonprofit organizations. 1,033 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 829 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Essex County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
